Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
9:26 PM

For programming under ₹80,000 go for 16 GB memory, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core i5/Ultra 5 chip.

Memory: 16 GB is the minimum. 8 GB gets tight with an editor, browser and Docker open.
Storage: 512 GB SSD, ideally with a free slot to upgrade later.
Screen and keyboard: a full HD, 14 or 15 inch screen and a comfortable keyboard matter more than raw speed, since you'll stare at them all day.
Graphics card: skip it unless you plan to train AI or play games. The money is better spent on memory and build quality.
Battery: look for 8 hours or more in real use, which Ryzen and Apple chips tend to do better.

A MacBook Air with an M-series chip can also come close to this budget during sales, and it's a strong choice for web and app work.

What kind of programming will you do mostly: web and apps, or AI and data work?
